title: Immutable admin proof rotor with region affinity and reportable manifests
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an orchestrator that continuously snapshots admin/activity streams into tamper-evident, append-only manifests with region affinity metadata and automated evidence exports for legal and compliance teams.
notes: Design decision: use a rotating snapshot 'rotor' that writes epoch manifests to a WORM-backed object store per-region to satisfy residency and immutable retention requirements.
Trade-off: Shorter rotor epochs reduce blast radius for tamper detection but increase write amplification and S3 WORM overhead; default set to 12h with config knob.
Privacy: Audit payloads will be redacted for PII at ingestion where applicable and raw blobs will be sealed in customer-specific buckets when Private mode enabled.

Implementation plan: 1) manifest schema + signer (ed25519) 2) rotor scheduler + per-region buffers 3) exporter with export-tracking DAG and resumable uploads 4) legal export API and reporting UI hooks.
Progress 2025-11-05: Prototoype manifest signer complete; integration tests for signature verification added.
Progress 2026-01-14: Region affinity metadata schema finalized after privacy review; added residency tag to manifests and retention metadata.
Progress 2026-02-20: End-to-end smoke tests pass on staging using simulated high-throughput admin events (50k events/hr).
QA plan: Fuzz event ingestion, signature tamper tests, verify WORM put semantics (object lock/gov mode) across AWS and GCP staging accounts.
Monitoring: Add Prometheus metrics for 'rotor_epoch_duration','manifest_sign_failures','export_resumptions' and a dashboard in Grafana.
Rollout strategy: Canary to 10% of Hosted accounts, then Dedicated clusters with a canary window; private deployments require operator opt-in.
Backwards compatibility: Provide a migration tool that consumes legacy audit-streams and emits sealed manifests; deprecation schedule to be announced.
Blockers: Legal to confirm export retention binding language for EU customers; S3 Object Lock lifecycle testing flapping in GCP emulation.

Acceptance criteria: automated signed manifests per epoch, per-region WORM export with verified signatures, export records available in console reporting, and no regressions in runtime latency >0.5% on control plane.
Stakeholders: Legal, Security, Platform Compliance, Console UX, Runtime Engineering.
Next steps: Resolve legal retention phrasing, finish export tracking DAG, finish console report UI, schedule security review.
